jobs.title: Senior Design Manager
jobs.descriptionPlain:
Gulf Development Company is hiring a Senior Design Manager to lead design governance for large mixed-use programmes in the Kingdom.
Key responsibilities:
- Lead design governance and multidisciplinary design coordination.
- Manage senior client and stakeholder relationships.
- Drive value engineering and design controls.
Requirements:
- Degree in architecture and strong Saudi project experience.
- Demonstrated team leadership.
- Experience with design management and programme delivery.
